conf.description: Apache Tomcat manager / json: thin pass-through, parsing deferred to Elastic (elastic-ingest-pipeline).

conf.comment: apache-tomcat / manager / json. Parsing is deliberately NOT implemented here: the Elastic ingest pipeline decodes this downstream (custom logs-apache_tomcat.catalina@custom over the JSON-decoded manager.*.log and host-manager.*.log files). Re-implementing that parsing in Cribl would fight it and yield duplicate or conflicting fields, so this pipeline only identifies the event and tags event.dataset, then passes _raw through unmodified. Direct route (no cross-domain guard hop).

functions.description: record why this pipeline does not parse
tag the dataset before Elastic parses _raw
